statements.text: The two shapes are congruent: same shape and size under exact superimposition.
A turn is allowed when checking congruence by superimposition.
The shapes cannot be congruent, because one was turned.

stem:
Rachna has two cardboard shapes of the same shape and size. One fits exactly over the other after she turns it.

Which statements are correct?

teacher.key_rationale: Same shape and size with exact fit means congruent; turning is allowed. Statement 3 wrongly treats a turn as blocking congruence.
